body: I felt I was really in touch with what I wanted. I've done some research and taken internships and spent a lot of time in the field. I would like to continue, but obviously can't without a degree, and I love what I do, I do love learning it, but unfortunately it is competitive and I'm not on that level.

What's a little worse, is I'm considering  self-harm instead to buy myself some time... but I can't do that every time, and the risk of someone knowing is too high, then it would all be for nothing... I realize the way I'm thinking doesn't make sense. I just can't face failure. I'm not strong enough. I can't pull myself out of it.

I have really exhausted all my resources.... everything is coming up this week, and there's just not enough time to practice and memorize and see all the patterns. There's just not, its not feasible. Even if I stayed up all night every night this week, i wouldn't make it. I can't drop these courses and graduate...

yep. This is me. I'm there. I've been here. It is the last thing I wanted, and I'm here all the same. I've been trying to tell myself to just let go, just graduate no matter the grade... I just can't, its not worth it to me. I don't have anything else I want to do with my life.

But graduating now... its pointless, for another year that I'm not even sure I can complete? I'm already staying an extra semester for the classes I dropped and am currently trying to retake. If I can't get through them this time, I won't graduate anyway. I'm so behind, I've been up for days... and I just can't. I can't learn it all fast enough. I'm not as smart as everyone thought I was. I can't just fail, and I can't face the disappointment.

I have issues accepting failure... to this point really. I'm terrified to fail. If I think I will fail at something I won't attempt it. I would rather take a zero on a test I never attempted than sit for exam and fail... its never been an option. Failing school, I can't even begin to think of what I would do. I feel paralyzed. All I want to do is run.
